config.label: Absolute path to a shared dotenv-style config file
config.description: Absolute path to a shared dotenv-style config file. When set, values are read from this file before direct environment variable overrides are applied.

config.label: Confluence host domain (e
config.description: Confluence host domain (e.g. your-instance.atlassian.net). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or CONFLUENCE_API_BASE_PATH.

config.label: Confluence API base path (alternative to CONFLUENCE_HOST)
config.description: Confluence API base path (alternative to CONFLUENCE_HOST). Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE or CONFLUENCE_HOST.

config.label: Confluence Personal Access Token or API token
config.description: Confluence Personal Access Token or API token. Required unless provided through ATLASSIAN_DC_MCP_CONFIG_FILE.
